description: What an agent did and is doing. `ToolCall` is one tool call: its name, a one-line summary and its status in words, with arguments and output folded away until opened (it is a [`Collapsible`](collapsible)). `actions` stay visible when closed: put Allow and Deny there for `ToolStatus::NeedsApproval`. `AgentSteps` and `AgentStep` show a plan as an ordered list.
name: tool_call
